name: Aarchid - AI Botanical Intelligence
description: Forensic plant-health platform: multimodal vision diagnosis grounded by real-time research-augmented LLM reasoning. Built as co-creator - PM + engineer.
imageAlt: Aarchid landing page showing the AI plant diagnosis interface and digital twin positioning.

name: Hackmate - Co-Founder Matchmaking Platform
description: Swipe-based co-founder matchmaking product shaped around founder-discovery pain points, matching logic, and community-led iteration.

name: KiteEdge - Portfolio Intelligence
description: [In active development] Self-hosted analytics platform for Zerodha Kite — 43+ indicators, Monte Carlo VaR, ensemble forecasting, a NIFTY 500 screener, FIFO trade journal, and Power BI export across 50 API endpoints.

name: ExperimentHub - A/B Testing Platform
description: Self-hosted, multi-tenant experimentation platform — deterministic variant assignment via a Rust MurmurHash3 core, Kafka event ingestion, a Python stats engine with sequential methods, and a realtime React dashboard.

name: DeskTasks - Desktop Task Widget
description: A task widget pinned behind every window at desktop level — natural-language quick-add, recurring tasks, reminders, time tracking, and honest .ics/CSV/Markdown round-trips. Local-first and accountless, shipped for Windows + macOS with an offline-first companion PWA.

name: Better-Half - Cycle-Aware Companion
description: Two-user, cycle-aware companion PWA for a long-distance couple — phase, mood, and stress drive daily guidance for her, him, and us. Privacy enforced at the database with 575 live RLS checks, offline-first, $0/month infra. Private by design.

name: Customer Churn Analysis
description: Built a predictive churn model that identified at-risk users and reduced monthly churn by 15%.

name: TCS NQT Prep Hub
description: Open-source TCS NQT preparation platform - 424+ practice questions, 10 previous papers, and an installable PWA with quizzes, flashcards, analytics, and offline support.
imageAlt: TCS NQT Prep Hub dashboard showing topic progress, recent activity, and study metrics.

name: This Portfolio - Meta Case Study
description: Applied PM thinking to build a production portfolio - from spec to deployment with 95+ Lighthouse scores.
imageAlt: Portfolio home page showing the Dhruv Singhal hero section and product-focused positioning.

name: Weekly Retro - Relationship Retro Decks
description: A playful product experiment: log small weekly relationship signals and an extensible scoring engine assembles a shareable 12-slide retro deck. Local-first PWA — IndexedDB, zero backend, 25 pinned reference cases keeping the scoring honest.

name: SKU-to-Storefront Pipeline
description: Deterministic batch pipeline for a retail client: bare SKU lists → enriched and verified product data → human QA gate → transformed CSVs and images → live WooCommerce products via REST. Zero LLMs in the product path, by design.

name: D2C Tech-Stack Scanner
description: Competitive-intel crawler that walks a brand's storefront journey — home → collection → product → cart → checkout — in a real browser and fingerprints every technology via Wappalyzer signatures plus a curated Indian D2C pack, reported to formatted Excel.
